subject: Veridian governance & eval operations plan (RFP clarifications)
messages:

Date: Fri, 20 Nov 2026 09:15:00 -0800
Subject: Veridian RFP - governance and eval clarifications

Hi Jasmine,

Thanks for submitting an initial response to our RFP. The evaluation committee had a few focused clarifications so we can assess Redwood's approach to model risk and compliance under both the NIST AI RMF and the EU AI Act. Broadly: 1) how you classify high-risk use cases and the controls you apply; 2) your regression/eval cadence and sample selection strategy; 3) telemetry and audit evidence we can consume during a pilot.

Could you send a short runbook and any sample reports or artifacts we could review? I've attached the specific questionnaire we were given by our legal team.

Thanks — we are aiming to finalize vendor shortlists by 30 Nov.

Best,
Maya Patel
Director, Procurement
Veridian Health

From: jasmine_liu <jasmine.liu@redwood.ai>

Cc: karthik_iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.ai>, lauren_bishop <lauren.bishop@redwood.ai>, sean_gallagher <sean.gallagher@redwood.ai>
Date: Fri, 20 Nov 2026 11:10:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Veridian RFP - governance and eval clarifications

Hi Maya — thanks for the clarity and the questionnaire. Attaching a focused governance + eval runbook tailored for your use case and a short roadmap for the pilot. High level first:

- Classification: We map customer use cases to risk tiers using a policy matrix derived from NIST AI RMF functions (Identify/Protect/Detect/Respond/Recover) and EU AI Act criteria (intended purpose, scope, impact). For items you flagged as patient-facing diagnostic assistants, we treat those as "high-risk" and apply additional technical and organizational controls.
- Regression & eval: We run a two-track approach — (a) continuous smoke regression on production prompts (prefix sampling + stratified drift sampling) and (b) scheduled snapshot evals (monthly) against your agreed benchmark prompt-suite with explicit pass/fail gates.
- Evidence & telemetry: We provide audit bundles (model version, config, token-level latency/cost traces), sample eval reports, and an API endpoint for event-level trace ingestion.

Action: can we schedule a 45-min working session early next week to walk through the runbook and align on sample sets? I've looped in Karthik (serving/runtime), Sean (risk & assurance), and Lauren (contracts) to cover technical, operational, and legal items.

Attaching: redwood-veridian-governance-response-v1.pdf (governance runbook)

Thanks,
Jasmine Liu

From: jasmine_liu <jasmine.liu@redwood.ai>
To: karthik_iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.ai>, sean_gallagher <sean.gallagher@redwood.ai>, lauren_bishop <lauren.bishop@redwood.ai>
Date: Sat, 21 Nov 2026 08:30:00 -0800
Subject: Internal: Veridian - quick tech + evidence plan

Team — passing along Maya's questionnaire and our initial runbook. Need rapid alignment before Monday's working session. Key asks and proposed responses below. Please reply inline if any of these are blockers.

1) NIST mapping: we'll produce a short mapping doc that shows which of our controls map to Identify/Protect/Detect/Respond/Recover. Include examples: model pinning + rollout policies (Identify), continuous KV/prefix cache integrity checks (Detect), automatic fallback to lower-footprint model variants under latency SLO misses (Respond).

2) EU AI Act high-risk mitigations: propose we offer a deployment topology that isolates PII via private deployment option (Private control plane + optional on-prem data path), mandatory model card and artifact package, and pre-deployment eval sampling with documented harm scenarios.

3) Regression harness: propose two concrete artifacts: (A) continuous smoke test runner that samples 0.5% of production calls + drift detector (statistical alerts) and (B) monthly snapshot report with stratified sampling across demographic/clinical buckets. Need to define sampling math with Veridian's team — propose 1k tests per snapshot initially. Also include a regression acceptance threshold (e.g., BLEU/ROUGE/semantic-similarity baseline + safety hit rate).

4) Evidence package: we can supply a zipped bundle with model manifest, timezone-stamped eval reports, token-level latency/cost traces, and the last 30 days of audit logs (redacted where appropriate). Compliance will want SOC2 Type II; Lauren to confirm what we can share for the pilot.

Technical asks for Karthik & Sean: can we produce an anonymized sample eval report (PDF) and enable the event-level telemetry feed as an S3/HTTPS consumer for Veridian? Also please confirm approximate time required to sanitize and export last-30-day logs for a pilot.

Thanks — Jasmine

[End internal note]

Subject: Re: Veridian RFP - governance and eval clarifications (mutual action plan + artifacts)

Hi Maya — great to connect earlier. Per our call, here's a concise mutual action plan and a list of artifacts we will provide for your shortlist evaluation: 

Mutual Action Plan (high level)
- Day 0–2: NDA/PEA executed (DocuSign) and access to Veridian questionnaire granted.
- Day 3–7: Redwood delivers governance runbook, anonymized sample eval report, and a model-card artifact.
- Day 7–21: Pilot onboarding — private control plane deployment (customer-managed VPC), telemetry feed enabled, initial snapshot eval run.
- Ongoing (post-pilot): Monthly snapshot reports, continuous smoke regression, automated alerts and quarterly risk reviews.

Artifacts we will attach for your review
- Governance runbook (attached)
- Sample eval report (anonymized) — attached as a zipped sample bundle
- Model card template (PDF) — included in the Drive link below
- SOC2 Type II attestation (summary) — we will provide a redacted copy under NDA

Commitments & notes
- We will map our controls to the NIST AI RMF and produce an EU AI Act alignment table focused on the high-risk use cases you listed.
- Regression sampling math: propose 1,000 stratified prompts per monthly snapshot; we will share methodology and randomness seeds so results are reproducible.
- Telemetry: token-level traces, model version, and latency vectors will be available via an S3 export or API pull. PHI will be redacted client-side unless the pilot explicitly requests encrypted on-prem ingestion (Private).

Next steps: signing link for the NDA and a proposed 45-min working session on Mon 23 Nov at 10:00 PT.

Links & artifacts
- Governance response: https://drive.redwood.ai/shared/veridian/governance-response-v1
- NDA / DocuSign: https://app.docusign.com/Sign/XYZ-VD-2026-NDA
